body.claim: Every command that writes a record threads the global --scope through to ops; forgetting it does not fail, it writes to a different ledger.
body.detail: Verified across all of them as of this commit: init, attach, relate, affirm, supersede, resolve, retract, repair and import all pass scope down. Nothing checks this. A new write command that omits it compiles, passes its tests and puts records in whichever ledger the resolver defaults to, which on a repository with both a shared and a local ledger is the wrong one, and the author will not find out until someone else cannot see their records. Migrate is the deliberate exception: it operates on every ledger it finds.
